dimensions.description: Semantically assess whether the decided contract is represented as one portable Agent Skill with trigger-first routing metadata, ordered steps, conditional reference loading, named dependencies, and resolvable pointers. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

Semantically assess whether the result reports structural mechanics without redesigning the behavior or claiming that routing and runtime behavior work. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: portable-representation-of-decided-contract
evals.prompt: Represent the supplied `evals/fixtures/behavior-contract.json` as a portable Agent Skill. Keep the behavior decisions unchanged. Use the canonical name `deployment-triage`, declare `incident-investigation` as a named dependency, and put failure-only detail behind a direct `references/failure-path.md` pointer. Return the represented Skill and a mechanics result; headings and prose may vary.
evals.expected_output: A portable Agent Skill representation of the already-decided contract plus a mechanics-only result that covers frontmatter, routing-description shape, ordered steps, conditional reference reachability, named dependencies, and resolvable pointers without making behavioral claims.
expectations: The deterministic gate establishes only the exact canonical name, description field, dependency name, and reference pointer.
The blind judge assesses portable representation, ordered execution, conditional reachability, and faithful preservation of the decided contract.
The blind judge rejects behavior redesign and any claim that valid mechanics prove trigger selection or runtime effectiveness.
Every semantic PASS quotes or references concrete output evidence; sampled human review checks contextual appropriateness.
Failed critical mechanical gates are non-overridable.
